candidates.source_name: ЕСЈН — Електронски систем за јавни набавки (e-Nabavki) — Public Access portal
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated single publication channel for all North Macedonian public procurement: notices (огласи), tender documentation, award/contract notices (известувања за склучен договор), cancellations and realized contracts. Every state-body, municipality, public enterprise and state-owned bank tender for POS terminals, card personalisation, ATM/cash handling, core banking or payment software must appear here. This is the densest primary source for the A2 workstream in MK.
candidates.access_status: public, no login required for PublicAccess module; bidding requires registered account
candidates.legal_status: official government publication, public information by law (Закон за јавните набавки)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the PublicAccess ASP.NET WebForms grids (Dossie/Notices/Contracts) with session + __VIEWSTATE handling, or headless browser; filter by CPV codes (30144200, 30162000, 302xxxxx IT, 66xxxxxx financial services, 48xxxxxx software) and by keyword. Standard WebFetch returned HTTP 403 on the root — treat as bot-defended, use a browser-like client.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from BJN website section listing
queries_used: е-набавки оглас банкарски услуги POS терминали Биро за јавни набавки

candidates.source_name: ЕСЈН — Реализирани договори / Institution grid data (contract realisation register)
candidates.why_relevant: Per-institution grid of concluded and realized contracts — lets you pivot from a contracting authority (e.g. a ministry, Фонд за здравствено осигурување, a state bank) to every contract it signed, including actual realized values versus contracted values. Key for sizing incumbent vendors in payments/IT lots.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Same WebForms crawl as the PublicAccess module; enumerate institutions, then contracts per institution.

candidates.why_relevant: The BJN/ESJN has stated it publishes concluded-contract data in a machine-processable format downloadable in one click, with a redirect link from data.gov.mk. If confirmed live, this is by far the cheapest bulk-collection route for MK award data, replacing page scraping.

candidates.source_name: Биро за јавни набавки (BJN) — Bureau for Public Procurement
candidates.why_relevant: System owner and regulator of ESJN. Publishes the legal framework, annual procurement reports, 'red flags' risk reports, handbooks for ESJN and e-Pazar, model tender documentation and technical-specification templates. Best pointer for understanding how MK tenders are structured, which CPV/quantities are used, and where the aggregate statistics live.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of /category/publikacii/* (annual reports, red-flags reports, handbooks) plus /propisi/* for legal changes; PDF text extraction.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query, then direct fetch of site index

candidates.why_relevant: Aggregate market sizing: annual totals of procedures, values, procedure types and category breakdowns for the whole MK public procurement market. Provides denominators against which banking/payments lots can be sized.

candidates.why_relevant: Regulator's own irregularity/risk monitoring — single-bid procedures, tailored specifications, repeated winners. Useful for flagging which payments/IT lots are effectively pre-wired to an incumbent and where competitive entry is realistic.

candidates.source_name: e-Пазар (ePazar) — electronic marketplace for small-value procurement
candidates.why_relevant: Below-threshold purchases (small POS/card-reader batches, receipt paper, terminal maintenance, small software licences) run through the e-Pazar module rather than full open procedures, so a register built only from open tenders systematically misses this long tail. The BJN user manuals document the module's structure and access path.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read the manuals to map the module; then determine whether e-Pazar outcomes surface in the PublicAccess grids — if not, flag as a structural coverage gap requiring a registered account or an FOI request.

candidates.why_relevant: Documents the ESJN data model — notice types, dossier structure, search filters, statuses — which is exactly the schema a scraper must mirror. Cheapest way to design a robust collector without reverse-engineering the UI blindly.

candidates.source_name: Државна комисија за жалби по јавни набавки (DKZJN) — State Commission for Public Procurement Appeals
candidates.why_relevant: Appeal decisions reveal the contested internals of tenders: disqualification grounds, technical-specification disputes, who bid against whom, and annulled/re-run procedures. For payments lots (POS, card personalisation, ATM services) the appeal file is often the only place bidder identities and evaluation detail become public. Annual reports give volumes by contracting authority.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Headless-browser crawl of the decisions/жалби search; also harvest the annual reports under /sites/default/files/zalbi/ which are plain PDFs.

negative_findings.description: A plain HTTPS fetch of https://e-nabavki.gov.mk/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: No content retrieved from the ESJN root by a simple fetcher. The portal is linked as the live ESJN entry point from bjn.gov.mk and appears in many current search results, so the most likely explanation is bot/WAF defence or a strict user-agent check rather than an outage. Recorded as unverified, NOT as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important source in this cell cannot be collected with a naive HTTP client. The collector must be designed around a browser-like session from the start (cookies, __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION, realistic headers), and liveness must be re-tested by the deterministic verification pass.

negative_findings.description: Fetch of https://dkzjn.gov.mk/ returned essentially only the acronym 'ДКЖЈН' with no navigable structure.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not enumerate the appeals-decision database or confirm whether decisions are individually addressable URLs. Annual report PDFs under dkzjn.gov.mk/sites/default/files/zalbi/ do surface in search results, indicating the domain is live and serves static files.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Appeal decisions are the richest disclosure of bidder identities and evaluation reasoning for contested payments tenders; if the decision search is JS-only, collection needs a headless browser and the effort estimate rises.

negative_findings.description: Neither the Macedonian nor the English searches surfaced any concrete, individually identifiable banking/payments tender or award notice (e.g. a specific POS-terminal or card-services contract) for North Macedonia.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search engines index the ESJN portal shell and institutional landing pages but not the individual notice records, which live behind the portal's dynamic grids. No specific лот for POS terminals, платежни картички or банкарски услуги could be cited.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that discovery-by-web-search is structurally insufficient for this cell: notice-level intelligence is only obtainable by querying the ESJN portal itself (or its open-data export). It also means no sample notice was available to reverse-engineer the record schema during this pass.

negative_findings.description: The ESJN 'Отворени податоци' machine-readable export is described in secondary sources but its concrete download/API URL was not found.
negative_findings.result_summary: BJN/ESJN communications state that concluded-contract data is downloadable in a processable format with one click and that data.gov.mk carries a redirect link, but no direct endpoint URL appeared in search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This endpoint, if it exists as described, would be the cheapest and most reliable collection path and would eliminate the 403/scraping problem entirely. Locating it should be the first task of the next pass.

negative_findings.description: The acronym 'ЕСЈН / ESJN' is used interchangeably with the brand 'е-Набавки / e-Nabavki' and one English search engine result questioned whether ESJN exists as a portal.
negative_findings.result_summary: BJN's own site resolves the ambiguity: ЕСЈН (Електронски систем за јавни набавки) is the system, e-nabavki.gov.mk is its address, and e-Пазар is a sub-module for small-value procurement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query construction and de-duplication must treat ЕСЈН, ESJN, е-набавки, e-Nabavki and eNabavki as aliases of one source, or the register will fragment into duplicate entries.

brief: North Macedonia's public procurement intelligence is unusually centralised: the Electronic System for Public Procurement (ЕСЈН, at e-nabavki.gov.mk), operated by the Bureau for Public Procurement under the Ministry of Finance, is the legally mandated publication channel for notices, award notices, cancellations, concluded and realized contracts — so essentially every state-sector POS, card, cash-handling, payment-software and core-banking lot must surface there. The practical problem is access, not existence: the portal root returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetcher (bot-defence hypothesis, not a dead site), individual notices are not search-engine indexed, and the advertised machine-readable 'Отворени податоци' export could not be pinned to a concrete URL in this pass. A resilient register should therefore combine a browser-driven ESJN collector with three complementary layers: institutional mirror pages and annual procurement plans (earliest forward signal, notably НБРСМ's own јавни набавки page), oversight bodies that expose contested detail (Државна комисија за жалби по јавни набавки, Државен завод за ревизија, the CCC watchdog), and TED/EU Publications Office for the IPA- and EBRD-funded financial-sector programmes that never enter the domestic system. Commercial aggregators exist but are paywalled and ToS-constrained — corroboration only, never the system of record.
